fact: The Finance Minister said full automation of 50 customs applications for import and export systems was completed on the Nafeza platform, which covers 99.9% of imports and exports through 15 logistics centres, with scanners linked to it on a pilot basis at Sokhna port.
title: وزير المالية: ميكنة وتوحيد 50 تطبيقًا جمركيًا للاستيراد والتصدير بجميع الموانئ
